mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may reduce the efficacy of nafcillin (beta-lactam antibiotic) by decreasing renal clearance and altering protein binding, while nafcillin may increase NSAID renal toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function and consider alternative antibiotic or NSAID if prolonged concurrent use is necessary; ensure adequate hydration and assess therapeutic efficacy of nafcillin.
